title: Prophit
tagline: Write a headline from the future. It becomes a token the market can trade.
description:
Prophit is a launchpad where every token is a headline from the future.

Write one sentence, and it becomes a token anyone can buy or sell. The more people believe it, the higher the price goes. There is no oracle and nobody decides whether it came true. The price itself is the signal.

Memecoins are fast but mean nothing. Prediction markets mean something but need approval and judging. Prophit gives you both: the speed of a memecoin and the meaning of a prediction.
how_its_made:
Contracts are written in Solidity with Foundry. Each headline is its own ERC-20 token, launched through Uniswap's Continuous Clearing Auction (CCA). Instead of a bonding curve that rewards whoever buys first, the auction finds one fair price over time. After the auction, the token trades in a Uniswap V4 pool with locked liquidity, and the author earns a share of the trading fees.

We use ENS to name and store every prophecy (for example badges-2028.ringo.prophecy.eth). The sentence is written once and can never be edited.

World ID makes sure each person gets only one prophet name.

The frontend is React + wagmi + viem on Sepolia.
auto_summary: A Sepolia launchpad mints per-headline ERC-20 tokens, launches them via Uniswap CCA, stores prophecy metadata in ENSv2, and gates prophet registration with World ID.
